    if any(ws_vals.cell(r, c).value is not None for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1)):
        candidate_rows.append(r)

if candidate_rows:
    data_start = min(candidate_rows)

else:

    data_end = 0

    """Treat numeric 1 (and simple text '1') as a 1; everything else breaks a run."""
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return int(v) == 1
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return v == 1
    if isinstance(v, str):
        try:
            return float(v.strip()) == 1
        except Exception:
            return False
    return False

# For each column, add the lengths of all adjacent runs of 1s only when run length >= 2.
for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):

    run_len = 0
    for r in range(data_start, data_end + 1):
        if is_one(ws_vals.cell(r, c).value):
            run_len += 1
        else:
            if run_len >= 2:
                total += run_len
            run_len = 0
    if run_len >= 2:
        total += run_len
    ws_edit.cell(answer_row, c).value = total

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb_edit.save(output_path)
